candidates.description: During its flight and lunar orbit, NASA’s Clementine spacecraft returned images of the planet Earth and the Moon. candidates.title: Horsehead Nebula
candidates.description: Rising from a sea of dust and gas like a giant seahorse, the Horsehead nebula is one of the most photographed objects in the sky. NASA Hubble Space Telescope took a close-up look at this heavenly icon, revealing the cloud intricate structure.
